text: ポケモンずかんは　パソコンつうしんで　オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる！

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: て-form plus もらう means someone does something for you. もらえる is the 'can' form. みてもらえる = 'can get (him) to look at it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says the means used. パソコンつうしんで = 'by PC link'.
